title: Tyny PDF annotation sidecar
description: ADR-0007. The sidecar is the source of truth for the annotation set of one PDF document; the annotations written into the PDF are a projection of it. Unknown keys must be preserved verbatim by every writer.

format_version.description: Integer. Never decreased, never reused with different semantics.

generator.description: Informational. Excluded from the content digest so that a save by a different tool does not look like an edit.

sha256.description: Hash of the PDF as last read. Used for reconciliation, never to refuse to open.

filename.description: Hint only. Path is never stored: it leaks usernames and breaks portability.

page_size.description: MediaBox width/height per page at capture time, used to detect geometry change before re-anchoring.

digest.description: Digest of the annotation objects this sidecar last wrote into the PDF. Mismatch means a third party edited the PDF.

annotations.description: Canonical order: page ascending, then top to bottom, then left to right, then id.

settings.description: Sidecar behaviour, not view state. Zoom, page and scroll live in the view-state file.

date_time.description: RFC 3339 UTC, second precision. Milliseconds are banned: they churn on every save.

color.description: sRGB. Suffix is alpha. Lowercase only.

id.description: RFC 4648 base32 lowercase, 10 chars, random, immutable. Stable across merges and unique across sidecars.

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF user space units, origin bottom-left, before page rotation. At most 3 decimals.

quad.description: One text line: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Matches the PDF QuadPoints order, so export is lossless.

anchor.description: Reconciliation data. Never used to draw, only to relocate an annotation when the document changed.

quote.description: Normalized extraction of the covered text: NFKC, case folded, whitespace collapsed.

text_sha256.description: Digest of the normalized page text of the anchored page. The first cheap test of whether the page moved.

score.description: Confidence of the last reconciliation. Below 0.5 the UI must ask instead of guessing.

type.description: file_attachment is deliberately absent: attachment bytes belong in the PDF, not in a text file.

page.description: Zero-based index, matching the PDF page tree order.

quads.description: Required for highlight, underline, squiggly, strikeout.

modified.description: Absent when never edited after creation.

deleted.description: Tombstone: kept for merge friendliness, dropped by tynypdf-cli sidecar gc after 30 days.

contents.description: The annotation body, as the user wrote it. Any language, any script.

contents_rtf.description: Optional rich text, verbatim from the PDF when present.

highlight_color.description: Markup annotations use HighlightColor, not Color.

icon.description: PDF annotation icon name, e.g. Comment, Key, Note, Help, NewParagraph.

family.description: Requested family. A missing family is a fallback decision, never an error, and the substituted family is recorded in font.resolved.

resolved.description: Written by the exporter so a diff shows when the fallback changed (delta D-4).

ink_path.description: Strokes of points in PDF user space.

redaction.description: Present only while a redaction is pending. Applying it removes the object from the sidecar and records it in the proof report (delta D-3).

label.description: Read by the UIA tree so the annotation list is usable without a pointer (delta D-5).

lossy.description: True when the source held something we model imperfectly; the UI shows a warning instead of hiding it.
